aboutHeader.title: Curating Architectural Pedigree Since 1994
aboutHeader.lead: Verdant Estates was founded on a singular conviction: exceptional architecture is not merely real estate—it is living art.
aboutHeader.story: For over three decades, our private brokerage has represented the world's most discerning families, architectural patrons, and design collectors. We operate with unwavering discretion, connecting rare properties with custodians who cherish their cultural and aesthetic importance.

pillars.title: Architectural Custodianship

pillars.title: Strict Privacy & Discretion

pillars.title: Global Private Advisory
